caption: The drawing features a single, large, brown ceramic jar with a rounded body and a slightly flared rim. The jar has a handle attached near the upper edge, curving from the rim down the shoulder. The rim of the jar is broken on one side, with jagged edges visible. The surface of the jar appears textured, with several vertical streaks in darker brown and greenish hues running down from the top to the middle. There are small dark spots distributed on the body of the jar. The jar is centered within a rectangular frame, and the background is plain, off-white, with no other objects present. The artist's signature, "Annie B. Johnston," is written in the lower right corner outside the inner frame.
title: Stoneware Jar
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
